description: CTO USB-01: prepare (VPS-side, reversible) a single, complete, self-contained, SHA-256-identified transfer PACKAGE of the latest valid operational-state snapshot, and document the exact human procedure to copy ONE version to a physical USB (on the LOCAL/transfer computer — the VPS cannot access the key), verify it from the key, and restore it in isolation. VPS-side export/package/verify/restore are executed + proven; the physical-key tests are NOT RUN here (human, physical hardware) and reported BLOCKED/NOT RUN. No source/stash/worktree deletion; no external transfer; nothing claimed about the physical key without evidence from the key.

authorization.authorization_source: CTO MISSION USB-01 — UNIQUE USB BACKUP & END-TO-END RESTORE VALIDATION (Phase B reversible VPS-side prep + Phase C/D human USB procedure).

work_item_contract.objective: A single SHA-256-identified transfer package of the latest verified snapshot (content-embedded manifest + summary + restore note), VPS-side validated (extract→verify→restore-to-sandbox==source, corrupt-detection), plus a documented exact human USB transfer/verify/restore procedure (single version on key; temp-deletion policy; no format without ID confirmation).
work_item_contract.claim_reproduction_rootcause: N/A (not a defect fix): durability V2 gives immutable snapshots; USB-01 packages the latest for off-VPS physical transfer. The VPS has no USB access ⇒ physical tests are human-run.
work_item_contract.scope: VPS-side: reuse odg-state-backup (export/verify/restore) + tar/sha256sum to build the package in the gitignored transfer dir; validate it. Doc: the USB procedure + single-version/temp policy. Git keeps the doc + this contract only; the package/snapshots/transfer dir stay gitignored. No source mutation.
invariants: Read-only on the operational source (export proven read-only).
Package is self-contained + integrity-verifiable (SHA256SUMS) + restorable (proven VPS-side).
ONE backup version on the key (package + SHA256SUMS + INVENTORY + restore note only).
No source/stash/worktree/snapshot/history deletion; temp transfer files deleted ONLY after key validation, by the human.
No secret/password/key in git/manifest/inventory/logs; package NOT encrypted (no secrets; scanned) — stated honestly, never faked.
Physical-key tests NOT claimed PASS without evidence from the key (BLOCKED/NOT RUN).
No external transfer; no format/delete of the key without explicit human ID confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: VPS-side: fresh export (read-only, source unchanged) ⇒ verified snapshot; package built + SHA256SUMS + non-sensitive INVENTORY; package self-check OK; extract ⇒ verify ok; byte-flip ⇒ corruption detected; restore-to-sandbox ⇒ 286 files, ledger+sample contract IDENTICAL to source; transfer dir holds exactly one package version. Doc gives exact detection/transfer/verify/restore/eject/re-read commands + single-version + temp-deletion + no-format-without-confirm policy. Physical-key tests = BLOCKED/NOT RUN (human). Committed doc+contract; archive gitignored.
stop_conditions: The VPS would need USB access (it doesn't ⇒ physical tests human-run); a format/delete of a key would be required (needs explicit human ID confirmation).
work_item_contract.rollback: git checkout -- docs/operational-backup.md ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md; rm -f runtime/missions/USB_BACKUP_TRANSFER_PLAN.json; (gitignored transfer package is disposable).

objectives.goal: Single self-contained SHA-256 transfer package of the latest verified snapshot, VPS-side proven restorable; exact human USB transfer/verify/restore procedure documented; physical-key tests honestly BLOCKED/NOT RUN; source/stashes preserved.
done_when: VPS-side package built+validated; doc committed; physical-key status BLOCKED/NOT RUN.

definition_of_done: A single verified, restorable transfer package exists (gitignored) + an exact documented human USB procedure (single version, temp-deletion, no-format-without-confirm); VPS-side export/verify/restore proven; physical-key tests BLOCKED/NOT RUN pending the human + key; committed (doc+contract, no force); source/worktree/5 stashes preserved.
